intro.purpose: Homepage opening line only — name plus the three section links.

list-item.purpose: Every list row: homepage recent list, Writing index rows.

body.purpose: Article body copy, About page paragraph.

label.purpose: Dates, excerpts, captions — always whisper gray.

components.name: Inline Link
components.description: The only interactive primitive in the system. Plain ink text, underline appears only on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #1b1b18; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b1b18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Article List Row
components.description: One row in the homepage recent-articles list or the Writing index. Title link plus an optional inline whisper-gray excerpt.
components.html: • On leaving a job I was good at — Notes on quitting well.
components.css: .ds-list-row { list-style: none; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-excerpt { color: #8a8a86; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 12px; }

components.name: Photo Grid Tile
components.description: One tile in a project's photo grid (/photos/{slug}): full-bleed cropped image, optional whisper-gray caption that brightens to ink on hover, links straight to the full image.
components.html: Lisbon, July
components.css: .ds-photo-tile { display: block; text-decoration: none; } .ds-photo-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0; } .ds-photo-caption { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #8a8a86; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-photo-tile:hover .ds-photo-caption { color: #1b1b18; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: One card in the Photos index (/photos): cover image, title that underlines on hover, and a whisper-gray photo count below it. Links to the project's own page.
components.html:
Lisbon

4 photos
components.css: .ds-project-card { display: block; text-decoration: none; color: #1b1b18; } .ds-project-cover { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0; } .ds-project-title { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 22px; } .ds-project-card:hover .ds-project-title { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-project-count { font-size: 14px; color: #8a8a86; }

narrative.overview: Plain text on plain ground; the words are the only thing performing. There is no navbar, no card, no button styling, no icon system — a page is a max-width column of text with generous top-of-viewport air (12vh–20vh vertical padding) and a handful of underlined inline links. The system exists to disappear: nothing here should read as "designed" in the sense of decorated. Confirmed rejections: no serif display face (an earlier design pass explored Georgia/slab serif treatments — the shipped system is plain Instrument Sans throughout, sans-serif only), no accent color, no chrome of any kind (no header bar, no card borders, no button backgrounds).
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Instrument Sans) at five sizes, no serif, no display face
Two-color palette per theme (ink/paper) plus one whisper gray for secondary text
Zero elevation, zero radius — completely flat
Layout is a single centered column; width and vertical rhythm carry all the hierarchy
Links are the only interactive affordance: plain text, underline only on hover/focus

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is no accent color anywhere in the system. Every visual distinction is made with size, weight positioning, or the whisper-gray recession — never with hue.

rules.name: The No-Weight Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the site is bold. Hierarchy comes from size and color (ink vs. whisper) only.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No shadows, no radius, no borders, ever. If a future component seems to need depth to read correctly, the fix is spacing or type weight, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep every new page to a single centered column at one of the four established container widths (480/640/900/1100px).
Do use whisper gray (#8a8a86) for any secondary/metadata text (dates, captions, counts) — never for primary content or links.
Do use hover:underline hover:underline-offset-4 as the only interactive-state treatment for links.
Do use viewport-relative vertical padding (vh units) for page-level rhythm rather than fixed px page margins.
donts: Don't add a shadow, border, or border-radius anywhere — The Flat Ground Rule is absolute.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a bold weight, or an accent color — The One Ink Rule and The No-Weight Rule are absolute.
Don't add card containers, chips, badges, or icon systems — the system has no container components at all, only text and images.
Don't add a persistent header/nav bar without deciding explicitly that The Quiet Page's no-chrome stance is being revised — it isn't a gap to silently fill.
